shots.note: wide from inside the ring: Haon walks in through the arched entrance, screen left to right, ember in her left hand
follow: camera ahead of Haon and to her right, retreating; ember visible in front of her belly, altar behind
insert: close on the hands, the left hand lowers the ember into the bowl, hand withdraws, one step back
low angle: Haon kneels with head bowed, the ember grows and flares above the altar
pan across the ring as the six braziers ignite one by one
low from the glowing ring toward the dark edge: the skeletons sag and collapse into rest
profile medium: Haon rises and lifts her head to the flame, then turns toward the entrance
two-shot from the +z side: the mentor walks in from the entrance, Haon turned to face him; they look at each other
smooth crane up from the two-shot to a near top-down over the lit altar ring (camera.up switch), holds the last 3 s
